title: Gemini Markets: Crypto Treads Water As Anthropic Goes Public
summary: The price of major cryptocurrencies continued to trade lower this week as investors focused on Anthropic's blockbuster IPO.
body_markdown:
*Welcome to Gemini Markets, your weekly read on crypto, stocks and equities, and prediction markets, all in one super app. This is the newsletter that will help inform you about what’s driving crypto and stock prices, tradfi market trends, and prediction market trends.*


### 📈 Crypto Markets Overview


**Crypto winter continues:**[The crypto market remained subdued Thursday, as risk assets waned after Anthropic shares pared gains following its blockbuster IPO.](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-19/bitcoin-bounces-back-into-green-ahead-of-anthropic-ipo) The price of bitcoin traded below $63,000 and ethereum remained below $1,800, failing to reverse their recent declines. The latest move comes as traders anticipate another rate hike from the Federal Reserve in December and inflation continues to run hot, both of which typically weigh on crypto prices. One bright spot: US spot bitcoin ETFs reversed seven consecutive days of net outflows on Monday, bringing in $7.9 million. Meanwhile, open interest in bitcoin perpetual futures contracts have dropped to $41.6 billion, according to Coinglass, the lowest mark since November 2024.


**Hyperliquid rival draws in $110 million:**[Crypto derivatives exchange Variational has raised a $110 million Series B round from Bain Capital Crypto, with Dragonfly, HSG, and others participating.](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261116481769/en/Variational-Raises-%24110M-Series-B-at-%241.5B-Valuation-To-Scale-On-Chain-Access-To-Global-Markets) The round values the Cayman Islands-based company at $1.5 billion, with funds going toward expanding the Hyperliquid competitor’s open interest limits, product offerings, and more. Launched in 2025, Variational has processed more than $475 billion in trading volume while open interest surpassed $1.3 billion across more than 100,000 accounts. The company previously raised $50 million in a Series A round in May.


**Bitwise eyes Zcash ETF on Texas Stock Exchange:**[Bitwise Asset Management has filed an S-1 to list a spot Zcash ETF to trade on the recently launched Texas Stock Exchange.](https://cryptobriefing.com/bitwise-zcash-etf-texas-stock-exchange/) The fund would be listed under the ticker “ZEC” and offer investors exposure to the privacy token’s daily price movements without owning the token directly. If approved, it would mark the second spot Zcash ETF to hit the public markets after Grayscale launched a Zcash ETF on the NYSE Arca earlier this year. Zcash has pulled back about 25% over the past month but remains one of the best performing crypto assets over the past year, jumping more than 44%.

### 📊 Stocks & Equities


**Anthropic pulls in $81.3 billion in blockbuster IPO:**[AI giant Anthropic completed its anticipated initial public offering on Thursday, raising a record $81.3 billion by selling 980 million shares for $83 apiece.](https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-prices-initial-public-offering) The IPO valued the San Francisco-based company at $1.5 trillion, with that figure reaching $2 trillion after shares opened trading on the Nasdaq at $111.50. But shares quickly dropped below $100 in mid-day trading as investors weighed the potential costs of the AI buildout. Still, the IPO was a seismic wealth creation event, with the WSJ reporting that a majority of the company’s 5,000-plus employees will become millionaires.


**Nvidia beats earnings, announces Huang won’t return:**[Chipmaking behemoth Nvidia posted $115.8 billion in revenue in Q3,](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/nvidia-nvda-3q-2027-earnings-report-stock-6e642303) sailing past analyst expectations despite former CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation following revelations of at least one extramarital affair with a company employee and a separate relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. During the earnings call, the company announced that Huang would not return as CEO despite some lobbying from shareholders for his return. Shares of Nvidia initially had a small bump after-hours Tuesday following the report before dropping again on Wednesday.


### 🔮 Prediction Markets


**Traders anticipate December rate hike:** Investors are all but certain the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by 25 basis points at their December meeting, pricing in a 93% chance the FOMC raises the federal funds rate to 4%-4.25%. Earlier this week, the Federal Reserve released meeting minutes from their October 27-28 meeting, with almost all of the officials saying they are in favor of raising rates by 25 bps in December.[Trade the December rate decision.](https://www.gemini.com/predictions/FED261211/fed-decision-in-december?status=active)


**Zcash at $900 by the end of November?** Even with the recent drawdown, Zcash has been on an impressive run in 2026 during a bear market as crypto investors seek out more privacy. As of Thursday, traders gave it a 54% chance the privacy-focused token will end November at $900 or above and a 38% chance it retakes $1,000.[Trade Zcash price here.](https://www.gemini.com/predictions/ZEC2611302200/zec-price-on-november-30?status=active)


**Georgia marches ahead as CFP favorite:** With just one blemish on their resume, Georgia entered Thursday as the prohibitive favorite to win college football’s national championship, at 37%. That’s nearly double Notre Dame, which checks in second at 19%, and nearly triple Alabama and Texas, which trail at 14% and 13%, respectively.
